Name: Buffoon Farm
Author: leafiot
Description:
EDIT: i fixed the top left-hand corner of the screenshots u saw, im keeping the old screenshots tho cos i think its funny

This Farm map replaces Standard, Riverland, Forest, Hilltop, Wilderness and FourCorners Farm (Beach has reordering issues for some reason, le sigh). What it does NOT replace is Meadowlands farm(because of the layout of the Chicken Coop and Fences, also im lazy)


This is my first customised farm, any bugs/visual tweaks you find(no you didn't), please report in the Bugs Section. Requests are in the general Posts. Have fun!


This was made with the help/advice from [url=http://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/91684178-liunianhui/]liunianhui[/url]﻿, until i figured out pathing and .json are my arch nemesises.
